content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I'm having trouble connecting [product_name] to the cloud and hope someone here can assist. I can't locate "Elastic Beanstalk Full Access" among the available AWS access levels, although I do see options related to IoT. I've been following the instructions in [document], dated 2020. If anyone can point out where to find Beanstalk Full Access, I would appreciate it greatly. Thank you, [user_name]
This might help: Workaround for deploying the [product_name] project to AWS. See [url].

Hello [user_name], Thank you, your suggestion worked. I successfully set up both IoT and [product_name] on AWS. However, I'm still unable to control [product_name]. The platform is showing a 'Deprecated' status. [IMAGE] I suspect it might be due to missing data linkage between [product_name] and IoT. Could you assist with this issue? Thank you, [user_name]
Sorry, I can't help with this matter as I don't use AWS.
Your help was valuable :) Does anyone else know the solution to this?
Are you able to view any real-time data from [product_name] in your dashboard?

analysis.insight_summary: Users are encountering difficulties connecting [product_name] devices with AWS cloud, especially with identifying necessary AWS access types, such as 'Elastic Beanstalk Full Access', which aren't clearly listed in the official instructions. Using community-suggested alternatives, users managed to set up IoT and [product_name] integrations with AWS but still can't remotely control the device due to a 'Deprecated' status on the platform, likely caused by missing data linkage between [product_name] and IoT modules. There's a need for more detailed integration guidance and improved visibility of live device data.
analysis.user_expectations: Users are seeking straightforward instructions for obtaining required AWS access permissions, a hassle-free process for connecting [product_name] to AWS services, and the capability to monitor and control [product_name] remotely through cloud integration.
